senses.gloss: , constr. וְלַד m. (b. h.; יָלַד) child, infant; young of an animal; offspring; embryo.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:1:5">Y. Yeb. VII, 8ᵃ</cite> <he>וְולַד בהמת וכ׳</he> the young of a domestic animal &c., v. <cite ref="M01495"><he>מְלוֹג</he></cite>; <he>וו׳ שפחת וכ׳</he> the child of a slave &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 63b:5">Sabb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>כבר נד ו׳</he> the embryo is already loosened (abortion must follow).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:6">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 2a:9">Sot. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>קודם יצירת הו׳</he> before the embryo assumes distinct shape.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>צורות הו׳</he> the successive shapes of the embryo.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:12">Kidd. III, 12</cite> <he>הו׳ הולך אחר הזכר</he> the child has the legal status of the father.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:12">Ib.</cite> <he>וְלָדָהּ כמותה</he> her child has her legal status; a. fr.—Pl. <he>וְלָדוֹת</he>, <he>וְולָ׳</he>; constr. <he>וְלָדֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:2">B. Kam. VIII, 2</cite> <he>דמי ו׳</he> damages for causing abortion.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 2:4">Bekh. II, 4</cite> <he>ולדי ו׳</he> the second generation of sheep sold on condition of dividing the young with the (gentile) seller until payment in full, v. <cite ref="B01227"><he>בַּרְזֶל</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:6:5">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>המקללת את וְולָדָיו בפני יולדיו</he> who curses his (her husband’s) children in the presence of his parents; Bab.
<cite ref="Ketubot 72b:5">Keth. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>יולידיו … מולידיו</he>, v. <cite ref="J00367"><he>יָלַד</he></cite>.—<he>וְלַד הטומאה</he>, v. <cite ref="A00017"><he>אָב</he></cite>.
